scope: Original feasibility questions and evidence requirements, not a selected or commissioned protocol.
response_rule: All answer/evidence/reviewer fields remain NULL in this checkpoint. A qualified reviewer must provide claim-specific evidence and signoff; an internal AI decision is not that review.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which physical ancestral stock and reference genotype could be authenticated, and are starting eligible variants excluded or measured independently?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Stock accession and custody record; reference sequence/version; independent parental genotype assay; documented starting-variant sensitivity and unresolved states.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: A published strain label without a stock-to-experiment join, or smooth/colour phenotype used to certify no starting variant.

field_rows.reviewer_question: What molecular allele definition maps an endpoint to W, A or M in this stock, including coordinate convention and marker background?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Versioned allele-to-route table with reference coordinates, indel convention, molecular confirmation and marker/plasmid joins; resolve the reported awsX 32-bp versus endpoint-span ambiguity before actual selection.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Morphology or reporter colour substituted for molecular route; an unresolved coordinate silently corrected.

field_rows.reviewer_question: How will compound, other-route and unresolved calls remain observable before selecting the conditional triad?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Exhaustive mutually exclusive adjudication rules and a worked blinded example retaining W/A/M/Other/no-qualified-outcome/unresolved/missing denominators.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Dropping discordant colonies or assigning all WS morphology to the triad.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Can a route-level control stand for the eligible alleles aggregated within that route, and what independently supported mismatch remains?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Allele-resolved control comparisons and aggregation rationale with a proposed uncertainty/transport treatment; distinguish observed route prediction from mechanistic route homogeneity.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: A single engineered allele assumed to represent all native route variants.

field_rows.reviewer_question: What endpoint and observation time can yield exactly one adjudicated outcome per eligible run?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Operational endpoint definition, timing justification, assay completion states and ties/compounds/censoring rules; retain the source unit hierarchy.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: A final sampled colony treated as the first mutation, first arrival or every lineage in its well.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which acquisition episode and exposure can be counted independently of surviving endpoint winners?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Episode/ancestor ledger and division or opportunity exposure; state how pre-existing variants, repeated origins, transfers, jackpots and missed episodes enter a justified likelihood.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Endpoint CFU fraction, recovered descendants or aggregate historical WS rates relabelled as independent mutation births.

field_rows.reviewer_question: What operational establishment event can be observed before terminal recovery, and how will observer errors be independently bounded?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Known introduced-lineage record linked to an earlier fate observation; independent reference/calibration including false events, missed events, identity swaps and unknown fates; preserve timing and ecological context.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Establishment defined by final recovered colony, or unobserved fate scored as loss.

field_rows.reviewer_question: What exactly enters each recovery calibration stage and how is the true introduced denominator verified?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Route/allele/context/phase challenge ledger, entry stage, verified introduced lineages, technical aliquot ancestry, correct/incorrect/ambiguous/unrecovered outputs.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Nominal concentration, reads or a late spike-in used as known earlier lineage totals.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which experimental unit supports the proposed marginal count law and which records share founders, wells, paired arms or batches?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Founder/run/batch dependency graph; one-outcome rule or justified alternative marginal likelihood; complete inclusion/exclusion map with correlated descendants retained as clusters.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Treating image fields, plate suffixes, descendant colonies or repeated measurements as independent biological runs.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which entire contexts and blocks could train the unchanged forecast without leakage into evaluation?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Candidate membership table with founder/batch/paired-arm grouping and prior-access history; explicit allowed training outcomes and calibration sources.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Splitting linked descendants across training and test or selecting contexts because curvature agrees.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which genuinely unexposed endpoint records or future independent blocks can remain inaccessible until freeze?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Outcome-access ledger, dated custodian attestations and split made before access; a later independent block if published/inspected endpoint outcomes informed design.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Calling already-known source outcomes held-out after hiding columns, redownloading or assigning a new split.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Over what independently supported establishment-feature range and context changes may training information transfer?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Training/target feature and ecological-state ranges, predeclared extrapolation rejection criteria and independent support for proposed transport.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Using favourable target winners to admit an extrapolation or deriving missing target F from those winners.

field_rows.reviewer_question: What population of contexts do the score weights represent, and can the weights be fixed independently of outcomes?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Target-context rationale and a proposed normalized nonnegative weight vector with timing/provenance; no actual weights selected here.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Reweighting by favourable results or post-outcome sample totals.

field_rows.reviewer_question: What independent trial numbers in each arm are feasible after accounting for rare eligible events, clustered controls and losses?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Costed arm-by-context design options with independent-unit counts, anticipated attrition, instrument capacity and blinded precision/power analysis; technical repeats shown separately.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: A chosen sample size inferred from a paper total or repeated image count without an eligible-trial model.

field_rows.reviewer_question: How will every allocated record, failed introduction, lost track, unresolved call and excluded run be retained?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Predeclared reason codes, stage-wise denominator reconciliation and missingness sensitivity plan, distinguishing structural absence from not measured.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Missing cells made zeros, lost lineages made origin-negative or exclusion based on observed route.

field_rows.reviewer_question: What total inferential noncoverage budget is scientifically acceptable for this single fixed study?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Signed proposed study-level error rationale covering the declared claims; explicit relation to prior looks and no renewal across research rounds.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: A default alpha adopted by this worksheet or silently refreshed after each round.

field_rows.reviewer_question: How will count uncertainty and estimated control/transport uncertainty share that same total budget?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Complete component/error ledger and valid joint coverage argument for the intended comparisons; no independent-errors assumption unless justified.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Treating estimated calibration bounds as exact or spending the same allocation twice.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which improvement in nats per qualifying observed triad would matter scientifically and be plausible?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Domain rationale and blinded effect scenarios under all comparators; explicit distinction from mechanistic effect or all-category performance.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Selecting a threshold after seeing scores or transferring a synthetic illustration as a biological effect estimate.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which possible score, uncertainty or admissibility results mean success, failure or unevaluable?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Prospective decision table covering every comparator, missing forecast, empty numerical region, non-rejection and category attrition.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Calling overlap proof of equality or a predictive gain proof of a mutation force.

field_rows.reviewer_question: What fixed collection endpoint and stopping rule can be committed before evaluation outcomes?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Time/sample-based stopping specification and operational deviations plan; any sequential alternative requires its own admitted calibration and amendment.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Stopping at a favourable score or introducing new interim tests without a calibrated rule.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Can a blinded design study show feasible precision under sparse supply, observer error, dependence and comparator similarity?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Executable independently reviewed design scenarios, success/failure probabilities and resource totals over plausible nuisance ranges; preserve the unchanged forecast algorithm.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Simulation success with oracle truth used as empirical calibration or generic power from ideal independent cells.

field_rows.reviewer_question: How large can control-to-native mismatch be in each route, phase and ecological state?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Independent matched transfer evidence across the R27 transport key and proposed uncertainty bounds; identify unbounded components and limits of J-only bounds.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Bounds fitted from held-out winners or an unknown mismatch declared zero.

field_rows.reviewer_question: If biological full-vector prediction is requested, what complete truth-to-called-category observation model is identifiable?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Route-by-called-category matrix including off-diagonal, Other, unresolved and unrecovered/no-event handling plus phase/context transfer; identify the separately scoped estimand.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Diagonal recovery alone or a contrast-only J bound used to recover latent full-vector/all-category probabilities.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which implementation can make the specified score decision with adequate numeric guarantees?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Versioned code and independent boundary tests, logarithm/interval policy, underflow/empty-region handling and signed implementation review.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Floating-point diagnostic output advertised as a certified decision engine.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which qualified group has materials, instrumentation, independent truth capacity and authority to assess this proposal?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Capability statement, roles, independence/conflict record, access/license constraints and itemized feasibility quotation when separately commissioned; no partner selected here.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: An author list or AI review treated as a laboratory commitment or qualified external assessment.

field_rows.reviewer_question: What dated registration and byte-level freeze will bind inputs, forecasts, categories, error allocation and stopping before unblinding?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Accession, immutable file manifest, independent timing/access receipts and amendment policy covering TMD and every complete comparator vector.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: A hash created after outcomes or a publication date represented as proof of prospective freezing.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which eligible biological system can support the intended native-origin question and common-background comparison?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Scientific system rationale, actual material availability and a match/mismatch table against the bacterial candidate or separately scoped translation target.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: A cancer or E. coli method lead treated as an admitted SBW25 system.

field_rows.reviewer_question: How can the actual founder and its pre-existing genotype be independently established?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Founder identity/custody, parental molecular truth and ancestry links with uncertainty; distinguish stock authentication from event-origin certification.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Assuming all founders are reference because an endpoint is smooth or a database record is labelled WT.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which native events are eligible, including event types the observer cannot see?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Versioned native catalogue with allele/locus/structural-event coverage, exclusions and molecular truth requirements; catalogue selection independent of winners.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: An assay limited to mismatches presumed to census all route-changing indels or structural events.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Is the existing ordered axis biologically meaningful for this candidate, or is this a different unadmitted model?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Independent scientific rationale relating eligible event classes to the fixed W/A/M order and axis; explicit separate-review requirement for any adaptation.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Reordering labels or choosing a new axis to improve curvature, including automatic cross-system transplantation.

field_rows.reviewer_question: How will one new acquisition episode be distinguished from inheritance, recurrence, transfer and descendant copies?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Parent-child event rules with time resolution and independent validation; record unresolved episodes and exposure intervals rather than exact unsupported birth times.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Repeated carrier calls counted as repeated births or sequence identity alone used to infer a single origin.

field_rows.reviewer_question: What exact native caller and reference produce variant and origin calls, and which stages are adaptive?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Version, configuration, reference genome, support/callability filters, training sources and adaptation audit; all failed/no-call states retained.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: A caller-selected truth set or undocumented sample-specific thresholds used as independent calibration.

field_rows.reviewer_question: What complete predicate determines whether a true episode can be included in analysis?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Formal carrier/reference/support/quality/recurrence predicate, eligible universe and zero-inclusion states; separate per-cell recovery from event inclusion.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: At-least-one recovered carrier substituted for a caller requiring several carriers and an informative reference branch.

field_rows.reviewer_question: What evidence establishes origin truth independently of the assay being tested, at the intended stage?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Paired ancestral/newly acquired evidence or another qualified independent reference with its own error limits; separately assess variant, ancestry and episode truth.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Bulk rate agreement, a fluorescent focus or reconstructed tree accepted as per-event molecular-origin truth.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which truth carriers and comparison/reference states jointly challenge the actual native predicate?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Predefined independent carrier/reference sets with ancestry, callability, multiplicity and selection history; blind truth assessment includes assay failures.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Reference absence treated as a true negative when uncallable; only successful calls included in a truth set.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which dead, detached, washed-out, unrecovered or unsequenced lineages retain molecular-origin truth?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Stage-by-stage loss ledger, last observation/time window, independent lost-state truth where feasible and explicit nonidentifiable/unbounded components.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Tracking disappearance called extinction without adjudication, or an imaged division used to infer a missing cell genotype.

field_rows.reviewer_question: How will false new-origin labels be tested using inherited/pre-existing variants as well as absent variants?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Distinct origin-negative variant-positive and variant-negative panels, each independently established with context-specific false-positive/no-call records.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Absence controls alone used to validate de novo classification, or unknown loss treated as origin-negative.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which independent founder/culture is the replication unit for native controls and how are nested genomes/calls clustered?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Biological-unit and shared-lineage graph linking cells, technical aliquots, sequencing libraries and batches to a justified likelihood.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Genomes from one pedigree called independent biological replicates.

field_rows.reviewer_question: How do truth controls match locus, genotype, copy/allele state, burden, physiology and ancestry of target events?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: State-specific match table and residual transport evidence, including marker/repair perturbations and lineage survival.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Engineered or bulk controls assumed to mimic native event states without a measured match.

field_rows.reviewer_question: How will joint carrier/reference calls and their dependence be validated for the complete inclusion rule?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Joint outcome records per independent episode/cluster, failure patterns and an admitted joint law or justified bounds.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Multiplying marginal call probabilities without a dependence model or equating caller concordance with independent truth.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Across which batches/contexts can measured controls transfer, and what makes that transport defensible?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Predeclared transport key, independently observed discrepancies and bounds; exchangeability assessment if an envelope is proposed.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Deliberately chosen media assumed exchangeable or a common instrument taken as complete context matching.

field_rows.reviewer_question: How does the native-origin uncertainty plan integrate with the single study error budget if that branch is pursued?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Cross-reference to the study error ledger, count/measurement/transport components and declared claim family; proposed bounds and missing-truth handling.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: A second hidden error budget, oracle truth assumptions or unreported multiple claims.

field_rows.reviewer_question: Which training-only adaptations are permitted, and how will a different candidate be identified before evaluation?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Versioned adaptation/freeze policy with allowed training information, independent evaluation access and explicit rejection of target-informed changes.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Adapting caller, axis, eta, comparator or eligibility after seeing held-out outcomes and retaining the original-candidate claim.

field_rows.reviewer_question: How will native analysis and stopping be jointly locked with the observed-forecast study?
field_rows.minimum_evidence_deliverable: Linked dated manifests, fixed analysis/stopping rules and deviations record consistent with study registration; no values supplied by this template.
field_rows.acceptance_condition: Qualified reviewers can justify the proposed value for its explicitly scoped claim using the deliverable; record uncertainty and unmet dependencies. Source identifiers alone do not resolve this field.
field_rows.refusal_trigger: Stopping by favourable mutation counts or reusing known outcomes as an untouched validation set.

gates.acceptance_requirement: Eligible physical system, stock, review scope and resource owner can be authenticated.
gates.refusal_rule: Stop commissioning if materials, rights or qualified review capacity are unavailable.
gates.first_feasibility_deliverable: A capability statement and stock/reference chain can make a feasibility decision possible; no outcome acquisition needed.

gates.acceptance_requirement: Endpoint route truth, exhaustive categories, experimental-unit hierarchy and marginal count law are admissible.
gates.refusal_rule: Keep prediction unadmitted if colony/colour units cannot be joined to independent runs or known calls.
gates.first_feasibility_deliverable: Request the source culture/well/plate/allele join and blinded classifier challenge frame before collecting more endpoint images.

gates.acceptance_requirement: Operational baseline/recovery predictors and establishment feature have independently calibrated denominators and observer errors.
gates.refusal_rule: Do not derive F or recovery from selected winners; unknown establishment remains unknown.
gates.first_feasibility_deliverable: A known-introduction observer-calibration feasibility assessment can show whether F is observable before recovery.

gates.acceptance_requirement: Unchanged TMD rule and every comparator can produce a complete positive target W/A/M vector using allowed independent inputs.
gates.refusal_rule: A scalar rate/curvature or partially parameterized mechanism is not an evaluable comparator.
gates.first_feasibility_deliverable: Produce a dependency inventory with named input measurements and access history; all actual probabilities remain unfilled.

gates.acceptance_requirement: Untouched evaluation units, precision/resources, numeric implementation, weights, error allocation, fixed stopping and immutable freeze are independently reviewed.
gates.refusal_rule: Known outcome access, unresolved count law or missing freeze keeps confirmatory prediction blocked.
gates.first_feasibility_deliverable: Audit access history first; if contaminated, require a genuinely unexposed source or future independent endpoint block.

gates.acceptance_requirement: Independent route-resolved acquisition, ancestry/exposure truth and lost-lineage limits support the chosen biological estimand.
gates.refusal_rule: Visible tracked cells or final genotypes alone cannot admit an all-birth claim.
gates.first_feasibility_deliverable: Ask whether a paired molecular origin reference exists before buying sequencing or collecting fate images.

gates.acceptance_requirement: Native complete inclusion/calling predicate is validated on independent origin-positive, origin-negative/variant-positive and absent-variant controls with joint failures.
gates.refusal_rule: Origin truth derived from the same caller, unknown loss or only absent-variant negatives blocks origin calibration.
gates.first_feasibility_deliverable: A blinded paired truth/caller feasibility sample and loss ledger can decide whether calibration is identifiable; sample count is unchosen.

gates.acceptance_requirement: Matched biological transport, allele aggregation and complete observation/generative model support the precisely named claim in addition to valid observed evaluation.
gates.refusal_rule: A predictive gain or J-only bound cannot by itself establish biological full-vector probabilities or a new mutation force.
gates.first_feasibility_deliverable: First cost independent mismatches by route/context/phase; unbounded components restrict or refuse the biological claim.

branch_rule: Observed prediction does not logically require native origin truth, but it still requires O1-O4, including the independent operational predictors used by the unchanged algorithm. The biological branch additionally needs B1-B3. All 44 registry fields remain NULL; conditional biological fields are not silently filled or made requirements for a differently scoped observed-only claim.
